body:
# As above, So below II — V2

> V1 is **DELETED**. Current tree: ~54 files / ~10,600 LOC.

## Pitch
Three z-levels (sky / surface / basement) in ONE RimWorld `Map`. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky, (2) performance, (3) full vanilla parity.

---

# 1. ARCHITECTURE

One `Map`, size `(w, 1, bandCount × Slot)`. Bands stack along **+z**; `band = surfaceBand + level`; bottom-to-top = basement / surface / sky. Impassable, permanently-fogged **gutter** between bands. `Slot = ceil((bandHeight + 2) / 64) × 64` — **64-alignment is load-bearing** (terrain shaders sample world position; misalignment shifts texture phase in the see-below view).

### Map sizes are CURATED (2026-07-28)
`Dialog_AdvancedGameConfig.MapSizes` is swapped by reflection **for the duration of the dialog only** (restored on close; other mods reading it see vanilla's list; reflection failure falls back to locking oversized options). Offered sizes sit immediately under a 64 boundary where the gutter collapses to 2 rows:
- **126** → slot 128, 48,384 stacked (1.6% waste)
- **190** → slot 192, 109,440 stacked (1.0% waste) — **cap/default**
- **254** → slot 256, 195,072 stacked (0.8% waste) — behind the unlock
The old 200 cap was one of the worst points on the curve (slot 256, gutter 56, **21.9% waste**). `Clamp` snaps to an *offered* size, not `Min(size, Cap)` — 175 would be inside the cap but pay a full extra gutter band. The dialog postfix snaps vanilla's 250 default (no longer listed) onto an offered size. Labels show the **stacked** cell count — that is what `PathGridJob` (an `IJobParallelFor` over every cell) actually pays.

### The one insight everything rests on
`Region.Neighbors` is **topological, not spatial**. Wormhole `RegionLink`s make distant regions adjacent; both ends are `RegionType.Portal` (stairs subclass `Building_Door`), which fails `ShouldBeInTheSameRoom` — so links conduct connectivity **without merging rooms/temperature/vacuum**. `Reachability.CanReach` is managed region-BFS and works **unpatched** — transitively fixing `ClosestThingReachable`, `RegionTraverser`, storage search, every `WorkGiver_Scanner`. **We patch nothing in `Reachability`/`PathFinder`/region traversal** — the key compat guarantee vs Clean Pathfinding 2 / Performance Optimizer / RocketMan, and why "patch reachability" suggestions get declined.

### ⚠ Portal regions are ONE CELL
Every door cell is its own Portal region; a wormhole must link **every cell pair**. `AB2: band info` prints `links armed = N/M cells`.

### The dividing line
Graph/logic (reachability, storage, work, hauling, needs) = **FREE**. Geometry/presentation (LOS, range, targeting, projectiles, selection) = **NOT free**; fix each at its own draw/compute site. Never patch `Thing.DrawPos` globally. Third category: **reachability-as-proxy** (vanilla using `CanReach` for "is this sensible") — fixed at the consumer (`WanderUtility`); un-audited: joy spots, meditation focus, animal pens.

### Hard 1.6 constraints
Pathfinder jobified — custom traversal lives at `Pawn_PathFollower` · `PathFinder` has no `FindPath` · `BlocksDiagonalMovement` trips on unwalkable cells, doors not special-cased.

### ⚠ Generation-window rules (UPDATED — carve moved)
- `ScenParts` (order 41) spawns colonists **during** generation; `FindPlayerStartSpot` is 40, `Fog` 48.
- **The carve now runs in a `GenerateContentsIntoMap` POSTFIX** — after all gensteps (vanilla and modded; carve-last semantics unchanged, colonists already spawned for rescue) but **before `Scenario.PostMapGenerate` and `Map.FinalizeInit`**. See §7.
- `ABBandMap.Setup` therefore now happens in-window: `ABBandMap.FinalizeInit` sees `Banded == true` on **fresh generation as well as load** (previously its Banded-gated hooks silently no-opped for new colonies).
- Genstep-time band math still uses `TryPendingSurfaceRect` (component unset until the in-window postfix).
- A slow-path fallback in the `GenerateMap` postfix carves post-init if the in-window patch somehow didn't run.

---

# 2. PER-BAND BIOME — SOLVED, VERIFIED
`map.BiomeAt(cell)` → `MixedBiomeMapComponent.GetBiomeAt` is 1.6's per-cell biome API; vanilla routes `WildPlantSpawner` (9 sites), `WildAnimalSpawner` (5), `MapGenUtility` terrain (10) through it. One prefix answers from `ABBandEnv.BiomeOf`, non-surface levels only (surface keeps Odyssey's mixed-biome grid). NOT the rejected ambient-latch pattern — the cell is a parameter. `Patch_WildPlantSpawner_ABBandDensity` was **deleted** (density would double-apply; its basement hard-zero blocked cavern regrowth). **Compat watch:** the prefix skips the original — a perf mod caching biome-per-map would flatten per-cell answers; `AB2: biome report` detects exactly this (`<-- MISMATCH`).

# 3. SKY VEGETATION — VERIFIED
`SeedFlora` seeds classified plateau cells at gen (was: zero plants ever). Sky biome **LOCKED to surface biome** (user decision); vanilla's per-cell `fertilityMin` gate is the species filter. `AB_OpenSky` = opt-out path only. Setting: `skyVegetationDensity`.

# 4. BIOMES! CAVERNS BASEMENTS
`BiomesCavernsCompat` ported verbatim; `ABCavernGen` band-scoped (V1 carved WholeMap); biome scribed as `ABBandMap.basementBiome`; `RunForeignGenStep` snapshots `listerThings` and destroys strays outside the band. Earthen Depths 40/30/30 pending play test. **Surface-band stalagmite check still not done.**

# 5. VANISHING COLONISTS — FIXED, VERIFIED
Root cause: carve destroyed colonists spawned mid-generation. Fixes: `Patch_GenStep_FindPlayerStartSpot_ABSurfaceBand` clamps the spot in-window (24-cell margin for pod scatter) + `RescueStrandedColonists` moves (never destroys) player pawns outside the surface band. `TryFindStartCell` does radial pass then **full-band sweep** (GenRadial caps at ~79.8 on a 200-band — "no cell found" used to mean "none within 70 of a guess"). Failure warning carries a **census** (unstandable/edifice/water counts; double-count bug fixed). Census once proved a surface band **100% solid rock** (tall-map slicing landing a mountain across the surface rows) — open design question: carve a starting clearing vs refuse the tile. **Undecided.**

# 6. CAMERA — ALL VERIFIED
- Wrong-level-on-load fixed: viewBand moved off a never-cleared static dict keyed by recycled `map.uniqueID` onto `ABBandMap.viewBand` (not scribed); `FinalizeInit` forces surface + explicitly moves the camera.
- Free pan: `CurrentViewRect` clipped to the band (one choke point covers `MapDrawer.ViewRect` AND the Burst cull job; `ThingCullDetails` is a private nested struct so patching draw sites was out). Per-frame memo; gated behind `freeCameraPan`; never returns a degenerate rect (Height-0 rects propagate into `GetSunShadowsViewRect` and Burst geometry — that was the red/blue artifact's sibling).
- **`ABBandCurtain`**: RimWorld's map camera never clears — unwritten pixels show stale GPU memory (the "red field + blue rectangle"; shader report was clean because *nothing* was drawing). Curtain draws `map.MapEdgeMaterial` at `AltitudeLayer.WorldClipper` — vanilla's own material/altitude, after `Color.black` (too dark) and `#1e1e1e Color32` (float-Color colour-space mismatch) both failed, and a custom material got night-tinted by the lighting overlay (queue 3100 > default transparent ~3000; **altitude is not draw order**).

# 7. MAP GENERATION — PROFILED, THEN FIXED (2026-07-28)

**`ABGenProfile`**: pairs vanilla's own `DeepProfiler.Start("GenStep - …")`/`End` brackets (depth-counted — gensteps nest their own calls; thread-pinned — DeepProfiler is global; armed only during banded gen). Reports one `Log.Warning` table: per-genstep ms + carve ms + start-spot ms + `FinalizeInit` ms.

**First profile (190×576, tropical):**
```
all 41 vanilla gensteps   1,304.7 ms   (Terrain 360, RockChunks 195, ElevFert 193…)
AB band carve             3,075.8 ms   ← 2.4× everything vanilla does combined
Map.FinalizeInit            164.2 ms
```
**Both prior theories died:** FinalizeInit's double-build is only ~164 ms (not worth reordering for), and "we're at the engine's mercy" was false — the 3× slowdown was **our own carve**. The tell: vanilla's `RocksFromGrid` spawns comparable rock volume in **78 ms**, because gensteps run with map bookkeeping **deferred**; our post-`FinalizeInit` carve paid live-map accounting (region dirtying, mesh sections, listers, incremental path costs) on ~70k spawn/destroy/terrain ops. Same work, ~40× the price, purely for running after init.

**Fix: `Patch_GenerateContents_ABCarveInWindow`** — Setup + Rescue + Carve now run in the generation window. Knock-ons: single region build on the carved map; `ABBandMap.FinalizeInit` consistency (see §1). Profiler disarmed before carving so GenSpawn's internal DeepProfiler traffic can't pollute the table. **A/B pending: regenerate and compare carve ms.**

**Not pursued (documented):** scoping scatterer gensteps to the surface band — their counts derive from `map.Area`, so 3× count × ⅔ destroyed nets correct surface density *by accident*; scoping placement without scaling count would triple density. Slicing ElevationFertility/Terrain per band — transpiler territory, biome mods read those grids, and full-height continuous noise is what makes the surface slice look natural.

# 8. RUNTIME PERF (measured, 96 pawns)
fps 59.6, f95 16.71 ms (vsync-pinned), tps 98.7% of target. Mod ≈ 652 ms / 2000 frames ≈ 2% of frame budget across 18 patches. `DrawDynamicThings` postfix nominally 458 ms but **contaminated** (RenderPawnAt armed in same run; our pass calls it) — isolated single-target run still pending. `GetBiomeAt` 55 ms/843k calls; `TryGetTemperatureForCell` 69 ms/719k. **`CompOf` now has a one-entry front cache** — published as a single immutable object because `ParallelPreDraw` worker threads could read two statics torn; reference assignment is atomic. Temperature patch resolves the comp once (was 2 CWT probes × 719k). `ABSkySync` absent from patch cost table = confirmed event-driven-free. **Phase-skip optimization in below-draw was tried and REVERTED** (user-observed regression; comment at site forbids re-attempt without measurement). Verdict on further micro-opt: not needed; game is vsync-bound.

# 9. SKY SYNC (BUG2/BUG3 fix)
`ABSkySync` recomputes the cell above on `RoofGrid.SetRoof` + `EdificeGrid.Register`/`DeRegister` (event-driven, no polling). Precedence: **constructed roof → `AB_RoofSurface` (walkable) BEATS impassable edifice → `AB_WallTop` (buildable only)** — roofed buildings walk edge-to-edge; `AB_WallTop` is only for unroofed walls. Natural roof → `AB_MountainTop`; else `AB_OpenAir`. Only the four derived terrains are ever rewritten (player floors/summit untouched). **`AB_WallTop` is `dontRender` + `ABBands.ShowsBelow`** — the top of a wall viewed from above IS the wall; two painted-texture attempts (near-black AB_MountainTop → black slab; grey tile → grey square) both failed before the insight. `ShowsBelow` deliberately NOT used by `ABCombatV2`'s hole test — seeing a wall top ≠ shooting through it. Event-driven ⇒ pre-existing walls need a re-trigger (rebuild/roof-toggle); one-off load pass offered, not requested.

# 10. BELOW-DRAW
Mesh layer skips realtime things by design; `ABBelowDynamicDraw` draws pawns (3-phase, bed-pose special case) **+ non-pawn realtime things from `DynamicDrawManager.DrawThings`** (frames are RealtimeOnly — under-construction invisibility; door blueprints forced RealtimeOnly while others inherit — the "arbitrary" tell; projectiles same root cause). All three phases unconditionally (see revert, §8). Early-out when no band below exists. 8 vanilla types override `DynamicDrawPhaseAt` and render pawns inside themselves (Corpse, PawnFlyer, GrowthVat, HoldingPlatform, GeneExtractor, SubcoreScanner, GibbetCage) — the reason phase-skipping was wrong.

# 11. STAIRS — ALL STALLS RESOLVED (three stacked bugs)
1. **Door could never open**: `tickerType Never` ⇒ `Building_Door.Tick` never ran ⇒ `openInt` false forever ⇒ `NextCellDoorToWaitForOrManuallyOpen` parked pawns in `Stance_Cooldown` waiting on a door that physically couldn't open (`SlowsPawns` is unconditionally true for unpowered doors; `AlwaysOpen` never assigns `openInt`). Fixed in `SpawnSetup`: `openInt = true`, `ticksSinceOpen` pinned. Applies on load.
2. **2×2 counterpart rotation**: `AdjustForRotation` shifts the rect **only for even dimensions** — counterpart spawned `Rot4.North` vs player's `South` put footprints a cell out of alignment while `links armed = 4/4` looked healthy. Counterpart now spawns with matching rotation; `TryCellPairs` compares width/height not Area (rotated non-square would silently mis-pair).
3. **Landing pocket**: carve was a fixed 3×3 around `Position` — for the 3×3 grand stairs that's *exactly the footprint*, zero approach cells; arrival pawns sealed in rock. Now `footprint.ExpandedBy(LandingRadius)` (internal const, must agree with `LandingCell`).
Plus `PlaceWorker_ABLinkApproach`: ≥1 clear **cardinal** approach required (diagonal-only approaches are structurally blocked); Mine designations count as future floor; planned impassable blueprints/frames block (PlaceWorker_Cooler pattern); far side deliberately not validated. **`placeWorkers` REPLACES on inherit — `PlaceWorker_DoorLearnOpeningSpeed` restated.**
`Carry` latent hole: pawn landing exactly on `realDest.Cell` runs neither StartPath nor EndCurrentJob. Unfixed. `LayDown` ×1 vanilla-attributed error noted — plausibly our mid-job teleport; recurrence + transit log correlation would confirm.

# 12. DIAGNOSTICS
`AB2: band info` · transit health · below pawn report · why is this pawn stuck · ABStuckWatchdog (verdict contradiction unfixed: inspects `nextCell` AFTER `ResetToCurrentPosition` set it to the pawn's own cell) · transit logging · below layer report · lighting report · bisect toggles · biome report · shader report · **ABGenProfile** (automatic on banded gen).

# 13. OPEN WORK
- **A/B the in-window carve** (regenerate, read profile) — immediate next test.
- **COMBAT**: 575 LOC implemented, never verified in play. Projectiles below now draw (below-draw fix); upward shots still invisible (see-below only looks down). Cross-band acquisition/shootline/accuracy untested.
- Solid-rock-surface tile: clearing vs refusal — **undecided**.
- Isolated `DrawDynamicThings` measurement · compat audit (RocketMan/Performance Fish biome caching is the known risk) · Earthen Depths temp · stalagmite leak check · Elevator (deferred; needs two counterparts) · Transplant (coastline + mountain-slice fix; **inland tiles until then**) · reachability-as-proxy audit (joy/meditation/pens).

# 14. LESSONS (append-only, telegraphic)
Classify by behaviour, not directory · benchmark that surprises you is usually broken · nested instrumentation inflates outer timings · `GetBodyPos` discards drawLoc for humanlikes in beds · `RenderPawnAt` self-heals only when `!results.valid` · malformed About.xml silently drops a mod · never mutate an enumerated collection from a callback · diagnostics omitting the discriminating field cost cycles; verdicts contradicting their own data are worse · **look for a vanilla API/object before building a workaround** (BiomeAt; CurrentViewRect; MapEdgeMaterial) · distrust confident comments about ordering (pawns-spawn-after-gen; counterpart-rotation "invariant") · statics keyed by game-scoped ids leak across games · "nothing drawn" ≠ black — unwritten pixels are undefined; clean shader report is the tell · altitude is not draw order; queue decides · float Color ≠ Color32 across colour spaces · Unity's own errors bypass the bridge (Player.log only) · **work done after FinalizeInit pays live-map bookkeeping ~40× over the same work in-window** · slot alignment creates value cliffs — curate sizes to the boundary · geysers destroyable=false · GenRadial caps ~79.8 · `MapDrawLayer.map` private · one self-contained log per event · **measure, don't reason — every unmeasured hot-spot guess this session was wrong.**

# 15. PUBLISHING
Live Workshop item **3773267907** with **V1's false-claims `<description>`** (elevators, shafts, psycast targeting, caravans, airships…) — user-owned, rewrite offered, not accepted. Stale: known-issues.json (V1), ARCHITECTURE.md, HELICOPTER_VIEW.md, V2-HANDOFF.md.

## TESTING RULE
`isolated=true`. Companions: **`astryl.Circinus`** (ex Modern Dev Suite; old id dead) + `astryl.ModernDevTools` + `BiomesTeam.BiomesCaverns` + `BiomesTeam.CoreFramework`. Playing-gated debug actions: use the Debug Actions menu, not palette pins. Banding happens at generation ⇒ new colony. Inland tiles. Transit logging + watchdog reset every launch.
